questions.question: The volume of a solid sphere is 4500 π cm³. The surface area of the solid sphere is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume of sphere = 4500 π

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

**Calculation:**

Volume of sphere = 4500 π 

⇒ (4/3) × π × r3 = 4500 π

⇒ (4/3) × r3 = 4500

⇒ r³ = 45 × 25 × 3

⇒ r = 15

Surface area of sphere = 4 × π × r²

⇒ 4 × (15)² × π

⇒ 4 × 225 × π = 900 π 

**∴ The correct answer is 900 π.**

questions.question: If x² - 4x − 1 = 0, then find the value of x² + (1)/(x²) - 5.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide the given equation x² − 4x − 1 = 0 by x to get x − 1/x = 4.

Use the direct algebraic shortcut: if x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Here, k = 4, so x² + 1/x² = 4² + 2 = 18.

Substitute this value in the required expression (x² + 1/x² − 5) : 18 − 5 = 13.

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x² − 4x − 1 = 0

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

**Calculations:**

Divide the entire given equation by x:

⇒ (x² / x) − (4x / x) − (1 / x) = 0

⇒ x − 4 − 1/x = 0

⇒ x − 1/x = 4

Squaring both sides of the equation:

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 4²

⇒ x² + 1/x² − 2(x)(1/x) = 16

⇒ x² + 1/x² − 2 = 16

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 16 + 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 18

We need to find the value of x² + 1/x² − 5:

⇒ 18 − 5 = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities for Squares

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2. Similarly, if x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Algebraic Identities for Cubes

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Sign Conversion Rule

The identity (x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4 can be used to switch signs. This implies if x + 1/x = k, then x − 1/x = √(k² − 4).

Where P = perpendicular ; B = base

(cosec²theta)/(2-cosec²theta)

questions.question: A tradesman marks his goods 25% above the cost price and allows his customers a discount of 12% on their bill. How much % profit tradesman realizes?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = 125% × cost price (C.P)

Discount (D)% = 12%

**Concept used:**

if discount is D% then,

M.P : S.P = 100 : (100 - D)

Where S.P = selling price

**Calculation:**

Discount % = 12%

M.P : S.P = 100 : 88 = 25 : 22

And

C.P : M.P = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5

Marked price (M.P) must be same

C.P : M.P = (4 : 5) × 5 = 20 : 25

So, C.P : M.P : S.P = 20 : 25 : 22

Profit% = {(22 - 20) × 100}/20

⇒ 200/20 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Calculation:**

Profit% = 25 - 12 - {(25 × 12)/100}

⇒ 13 - 3 = 10%

∴ The correct answer is 10%.

questions.question: If 7 divides the integer n, then the remainder is 2. What will be the remainder if 9n is divided by 7?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisor = 7

Remainder = 2

**Formula used:**

Dividend = (divisor × quotient) + remainder

**Calculation:**

Dividend = (divisor × quotient) + remainder

⇒ n = (7 × q) + 2

Multiply both sides by 9

⇒ 9n = (63 × q) + 18

(63 × q) is divisible by 7.

So, the remainder of 18/7 = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4. **

questions.question: Two circles touch each other externally at any point C. PQ is the direct common tangent to both the circles touching the circles at point P and point Q. If the radii of the circles are 36 cm and 16 cm, respectively, then the length of PQ is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of 1st circle = 36 cm

Radius of 2nd circle = 16 cm

**Formula used:**

If two circle touches each other externally and a common tangent is passing then,

Length of common tangent = √(4 × r₁ × r₂)

**Calculation:**

Length of common tangent (PQ) = √(4 × 36 × 16)

⇒ 2 × 6 × 4 = 48 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

questions.question: The algebraic expression 4x² - y² + 6y - 9 is equal to ______.
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

a² - b² = (a + b) (a - b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4x2 - y2 + 6y - 9

⇒ 4x2 - (y2 - 6y + 9)

⇒ 4x2 - (y - 3)²

⇒ (2x)² - (y - 3)2

⇒ (2x + y - 3) (2x - y + 3)

**∴ The correct answer is (2x + y - 3) (2x - y + 3).**

x = (√6-1)⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾

**Formula used:**

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab × (a - b)

**Calculation:**

x = (√6-1)⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾

Cube both sides

⇒ x³ = √6 - 1

putting the value of x in inverse

(1/x³) = 1/(√6 - 1)

⇒ (√6 + 1)/(√6)² - 1

⇒ (√6 + 1)/5

Putting the values in the equation:

(x-(1)/(x))³+3(x-(1)/(x))

⇒ x³ - (1/x³) - 3(x - 1/x) + 3(x - 1/x)

⇒ √6 - 1 - {(√6 + 1)/5}

⇒ (5√6 - 5 - √6 - 1)/5

⇒ (4√6 - 6)/5

**∴ The correct answer is (4sqrt6-6)/(5).**
